grainsPantry: Millets: Proso Millet (for Pongal), Foxtail Millet, and Broken Jowar.
Rice: Unpolished Rice and Brown Rice.
Other Grains: Quinoa, Semolina (Rava), Broken Wheat (Daliya), and Vermicelli.
Flours: Ragi (Finger Millet) flour and Whole Wheat flour.
proteinsDals: Green Moong: Whole Green Moong and Moong Dal (Split).
Chickpeas: Kabuli Chana (for chat and pulav).
Lentils: Tur Dal (for porridge and daliya).
Nuts & Seeds: Almonds, Walnuts, Flax seeds, Pumpkin seeds, and Peanuts.
Snacks: Makhana (Fox nuts) and Puffed Rice.
freshVegetables: The Superfoods: Lady Finger (Okra) — buy enough for 3–4 meals (approx. 1kg).
Gourds: Bottle Gourd (Lauki) and Ash Gourd (pantry fiber alternate).
Leafy Greens: Agathi Leaves (Hummingbird tree leaves), Methi (Fenugreek), and Dill leaves.
Daily Veggies: Carrots, French beans, Bell peppers (Capsicum), and Cucumber.
Aromatics: Tomatoes, Onions, Ginger, Garlic, and Green chillies.
seasonalFruits: Recommended: Papaya, Pomegranate (excellent for blood flow), Guava, or Mosambi (Sweet Lime).
Note: Since you are monitoring sugar levels, focus on low-glycemic fruits like Guava or Berries if available.
spicesHerbs: Key Items: Cinnamon sticks (for daily use), Chasteberry (Vitex) tea/leaves, and Tulsi leaves.
Essential Seeds: Cumin seeds, Coriander seeds, Bay leaves, and Cloves.
Others: Mustard seeds, Turmeric, and Mint leaves (for pudina chutney).
dairyFats: Dairy: Fresh Curd/Yogurt (for Rava Idli and Buttermilk).
Cooking Fats: Cold-pressed Olive Oil or Pure Ghee (use sparingly as per your cholesterol focus).

yogaClass: Take a small meal 30 mins before the class.
Do not go empty stomach as you will feel exhausted.
Fix the timing and join the same session as far as possible to help with a set routine.
Try to give intervals between every 2-3 hours, avoid long sitting hours.
